description: Gets items referring to a Sitecore item, showing which items reference it.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item to retrieve referrers for. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language of the item to check referrers for

path.description: The path of the item to retrieve referrers for (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply this or id.

version.description: The version of the item to check referrers for

name: common-get-item-referrer
